description: This file declares interfaces and factory classes for the WebAudioPlayerModule service in the Rialto media server IPC component. It defines the IWebAudioPlayerModuleService interface with methods for client connection management, and a factory class for creating instances of the service.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayerModuleService.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the WebAudioPlayerModule service, providing methods for client connection management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IWebAudioPlayerModuleService instance, given a reference to IWebAudioPlayerService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection of a client from the IPC service.
